conditions: standard_user signs in, adds a product, goes to checkout, fills in first name 'Jane', last name 'Doe', postal code '12345', and clicks Continue
items.expected: The Continue button is accepted (no error shown) AND the Checkout: Overview page is displayed with those details processed

conditions: standard_user completes the checkout flow and clicks Finish on the overview page
items.expected: The Finish button is accepted AND the thank-you message 'Thank you for your order!' is displayed

conditions: error_user signs in, adds a product, goes to checkout, fills in details, reaches the overview, and clicks Finish
items.expected: The Finish button is accepted AND the thank-you message is displayed (expected to fail — Active bug #122: error_user cannot finish an order)

conditions: standard_user completes checkout and reaches the thank-you confirmation page; axe-core scans the page with WCAG 2.x rules
items.expected: No accessibility violations are reported (violations array is empty)

conditions: unauthenticated user navigates directly to the checkout-complete URL without signing in
items.expected: The sign-in page is shown instead of the confirmation page

excluded.what: bug #121 [Active] Problem user sees the same picture for every product
excluded.reason: This bug is about the product list display, not the checkout flow — it does not touch story 120's behaviour
